title: Full-Text Search & Text Analysis
subtitle: Rank documents by BM25 relevance, tokenize text, and stem words with Snowball stemmers for many languages.
provenance: Actual catalog tags from the released runtime used by the notebook

runtime_export.query: SELECT database_name, comment, map_extract_value(tags,'vgi.title') AS title, map_extract_value(tags,'vgi.subtitle') AS subtitle FROM duckdb_databases() WHERE map_extract_value(tags,'vgi.title') IS NOT NULL
rows: Full-text search (BM25 ranking), tokenization, and Snowball stemming, powered by the tantivy search engine.
Rank documents by BM25 relevance, tokenize text, and stem words with Snowball stemmers for many languages.
